title: Third-Party Risk Intake
description: Report a third-party vendor and the software, services, or data flows they provide. One submission can cover multiple items from the same vendor.

elements.name: submitter_name
elements.title: Your name

elements.name: submitter_email
elements.title: Your work email

elements.name: department
elements.title: Requesting department

elements.name: business_owner
elements.title: Business owner of this relationship
elements.description: Who owns the decision to use this vendor? Leave blank if that is you.

elements.name: request_reason
elements.title: What are you reporting?

choices.text: A new third party we want to use
A change to a third party we already use
A renewal of an existing third party
A third party already in use that was never reviewed

pages.name: vendor
pages.title: The vendor
pages.description: The company or legal entity. We check this against our existing inventory as you type.

elements.name: vendor_legal_name
elements.title: Vendor legal / company name

elements.name: vendor_website
elements.title: Vendor website or primary domain

elements.name: match_redirect
elements.title: We found a possible match in our inventory

elements.name: match_redirect_note
elements.html: This vendor or item may already exist. Approved items can be adopted directly; rejected items require the exception process. Tell us how to proceed.

elements.name: match_action
elements.title: How would you like to proceed?

choices.text: This is the same item already on file - stop here
This is a different item from the same vendor - continue
Not sure - route me to the TPRM team

pages.name: items
pages.title: The third-party items
pages.description: Add each distinct software, service, or data flow this vendor provides. Add as many as apply.

elements.name: third_party_items
elements.title: Items provided by this vendor
elements.panelAddText: Add another item from this vendor

choices.text: Data processor (handles our data on our behalf)

templateElements.name: item_description
templateElements.title: What is it and what does it do?

templateElements.name: business_purpose
templateElements.title: Why do we need it? (business purpose)

templateElements.name: data_types
templateElements.title: What data will this item store, process, or transmit?

templateElements.name: data_actions
templateElements.title: How does it handle that data?

templateElements.name: data_security_deep_dive
templateElements.title: Data security details
templateElements.description: Shown because this item handles sensitive data.

elements.name: encryption_rest
elements.title: Is our data encrypted at rest?

elements.name: encryption_transit
elements.title: Is our data encrypted in transit?

elements.name: breach_notification
elements.title: Does the vendor contractually commit to breach notification?

elements.name: uses_subprocessors
elements.title: Does the vendor use subprocessors for our data?

elements.name: data_residency
elements.title: Where is our data stored?

elements.name: attestations
elements.title: Which attestations does the vendor hold?

templateElements.name: integrates
templateElements.title: Does this item integrate with, or get access to, our systems, network, or accounts?

templateElements.name: access_deep_dive
templateElements.title: Access and integration details
templateElements.description: Shown because this item connects to our environment.

elements.name: integration_types
elements.title: How does it connect?

elements.name: auth_method
elements.title: Primary authentication method

elements.name: privileged_access
elements.title: Does it require privileged or admin access?

templateElements.name: criticality
templateElements.title: How critical is this item to the business?

templateElements.name: resilience_deep_dive
templateElements.title: Business continuity details
templateElements.description: Shown because this item is business-critical.

elements.name: users_affected
elements.title: How many people rely on it?

elements.name: downtime_tolerance
elements.title: How long could we tolerate it being down?

elements.name: alternative_exists
elements.title: Is there an alternative or fallback if this vendor fails?

templateElements.name: provisional_tier
templateElements.title: Provisional risk tier (auto-calculated)
templateElements.expression: iif({panel.data_types} anyof ['phi','pci','secrets'] or {panel.privileged_access} = true, 'Tier 1 - High', iif({panel.data_types} anyof ['pii','financial'] or {panel.criticality} >= 4 or {panel.integrates} = true, 'Tier 2 - Medium', 'Tier 3 - Low'))

elements.name: contract_status
elements.title: Is there a contract?

elements.name: contract_owner
elements.title: Contract owner

elements.name: clm_reference
elements.title: Leah CLM record ID or link, if known

elements.name: annual_spend
elements.title: Approximate annual spend

elements.name: exhibits_attached
elements.title: Which security exhibits are attached to the current contract, if known?
elements.description: Leave blank if unknown. Our review will confirm which exhibits should apply.

elements.name: next_steps
elements.html: After you submit, the TPRM team confirms there are no duplicates, sets the risk tier, and runs the contract-language review to determine which security exhibits to require. You will get a ticket reference by email.

elements.name: attestation
elements.title: I confirm this information is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
